site_name: LAND TO THE EAST AND WEST OF
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 76293/APP/2021/1158 dated 07-07-2021 (Request for approval of plans and specifications under condition imposed by Schedule 17 to the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017 relating to two underbridges including retaining wingwalls; noise barriers; and two embankments including retaining walls) to correct the labels relating to noise barriers on the approved plans.
decision_conditions: Only amendments which are subject to Schedule 17 approval are considered under this application for non-material changes to the labelling of the noise barriers along the sides of the track leading up to West Ruislip Portal end of the Northolt Tunnel. The amendments sought for approval relate to:
- Re-labelling the barriers on the northern side to Type B design specifications and the barriers on the southern side to Type A design specifications.

The proposals are considered to represent an approval the authority could have given originally and are considered to be non-material. As such, the application is recommended for approval, in accordance with Schedule 17, Part 1, Paragraph 21 (Non-material changes to approvals), of the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017.

This approved non-material amendment supersedes approved plan ref. 1MC03-SCJ_SDH-AR-DGA-S000-999001 Rev P05  from application ref. 76293/APP/2021/1158 dated 07-07-2021 with plan ref. 1MC03-SCJ_SDH-AR-DGA-S000-999001 Rev C04.

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, all other conditions relating to application ref. 76293/APP/2021/1158 (dated 07-07-21), must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
